leaf_results.output:
### SUMMARY

Rewrote the AE350 app to run the emulated TI-89 Titanium continuously: one 60 Hz frame of emulated time (200,000 M68K cycles) per iteration, presentation following the fabric's vertical blank, and Wii Classic Controller input folded into TiEmu's keypad. Also added the fabric's video/pad register contract to the platform header and linked the existing pad module into the app build.

Key implementation points (all in `firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke/main.c`):
- Boot path kept verbatim (flash size check, malloc/memcpy, `img_infos`/`params`, `hw_init`/`hw_reset`, `Tiny89 BOOT SSP=… PC=…`) and `lcd_hash()` unchanged; LCD extraction unchanged (30 bytes/row MSB-first, 160x100 at x48 y70, palette 0 `0x9fb58f`, palette 1 `0x182018`, D-cache write-back before enabling video).
- Pad ID read exactly once; `Tiny89 PAD OK ID=544e5031` (then `T89_PAD_CTRL = 187`, 100 kHz) or `Tiny89 PAD NONE ID=%08x`, in which case `have_pad == 0` and the whole session runs with no input — a missing pad never fails the boot.
- `for (;;)` loop: (a) `hw_m68k_run(2000000, 200000)` → `BAD Tiny89 CPU result=%d` + `return 1` on non-zero; (b) `poll_pad()` samples controller 0 only when `T89_PAD_READS(STATUS)` has *changed*, decodes with `t89_pad_decode(DATA, DATA2 & 0xffff)` when PRESENT|CLASSIC (else an all-zero pad so nothing stays pressed), then `t89_keymap_update(..., 32)` and `ti68k_kbd_set_key()` per event with a range guard against keys outside `0..NB_MAX_KEYS-1`; (c) renders the *back* buffer, `t89_dcache_wbinval()`, then flips `T89_VIDEO_CTRL`'s buffer bit, only when `FRAMES` has advanced; (d) `Tiny89 READY PC=%08x LCD=%08x` printed exactly once at 300 presented frames or 30 consecutive unchanged-hash presentations; (e) heartbeat every 60 presented frames in the exact requested layout; (f) no `hw_exit()`, no `break`, only the `BAD …` paths return.
- No wall-clock pacing anywhere; `t89_cycles64()` is deliberately not consulted.

### EVIDENCE

```
$ make -C firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke OS_IMAGE=$PWD/build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw TIEMU_ROOT=$PWD/third_party/tiemu
make: Entering directory '/run/media/vash/GIT/Tiny89/firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke'
   text	   data	    bss	    dec	    hex	filename
4627178	  34584	 455636	5117398	 4e15d6	/run/media/vash/GIT/Tiny89/build/firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke/tiemu_smoke.elf
make: Leaving directory '/run/media/vash/GIT/Tiny89/firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke'
EXIT=0
```
- ELF path: `/run/media/vash/GIT/Tiny89/build/firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke/tiemu_smoke.elf`
- ELF file size: `9805012` bytes (`stat -c %s`); load image (`objcopy -O binary`) `4661764` bytes at `0x40000000`
- SHA-256: `8943f1550b6e1319ab94cb37c7f4e59762e877d33bee8fa72f1bec86e0229294`
- Entry point (`readelf -h`): `0x40000000`; `Type: EXEC`
- `nm` shows `main`, `render_lcd`, `t89_pad_decode`, `t89_keymap_reset`, `t89_keymap_update`, `ti68k_kbd_set_key` linked; new object `build/obj/app/t89_pad.c.o` built in the app obj tree with no name collision.
- `strings` on the ELF contains `Tiny89 PAD OK ID=544e5031`, `Tiny89 PAD NONE ID=%08lx`, `Tiny89 READY PC=%08lx LCD=%08lx`, `Tiny89 FRAME n=%u PC=%08lx CYC=%u LCD=%08lx VBL=%u PAD=%04x KEYS=%d LAYER=%s`, `BAD Tiny89 CPU result=%d`, `BAD Tiny89 pad result=%d`.
- Re-ran the untouched pad module's host test: `bash tests/run_t89_pad_test.sh` → `t89_pad: 188 checks passed`, exit 0.
- `-Wall -Wextra -Wformat=2` cross-compile of the new `main.c`: only two pre-existing warnings (`__inline` in TiEmu's `hw.h`; `img_infos.data = flash` signedness, also in the old file). No warnings from new code.
- Register contract cross-checked against TinyNES's `firmware/include/tinynes.h` (recovered text): `TN_VIDEO_FRAMES 0x10008`, `TN_VIDEO_BUFFER 0x2`, `TN_VIDEO_VBLANK 0x1`, `TN_VIDEO_SHOWING 0x4`, `TN_PAD_ID/CTRL/STATUS/DATA/DATA2` offsets, `TNP1 = 0x544e5031`, `READS = (s>>8)&0xffff`, `QUARTER_100K = 187` all match.
- No deployment or board command was run (no `tools/deploy-ae350-probe.sh`, no `/dev/ttyACM0`, no serial/probe/board access of any kind). `git diff --name-only` = only the three permitted files.

### CHANGES

- `firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke/main.c` — rewritten: continuous boot→loop session with per-frame emulation, vblank-paced double-buffered presentation, pad polling/keyboard injection, one-shot READY, 60-frame heartbeat.
- `firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke/Makefile` — added `-I$(ROOT)/firmware/common` to `CPPFLAGS`, added `firmware/common/t89_pad.c` to `APP_SOURCES` with its own compile rule into `build/obj/app/`; nothing else touched.
- `firmware/include/tiny89_platform.h` — added `T89_VIDEO_FRAMES`, CTRL/STATUS bit names and the Wii pad register block (ID/CTRL/STATUS/DATA/DATA2/IDENT, `TNP1`, PRESENT/CLASSIC, `T89_PAD_READS`, `T89_PAD_QUARTER_100K`); existing definitions unchanged.

### RISKS

- Cannot be verified on hardware here (forbidden), so the loop, READY timing, vblank pacing and controller 0 behaviour are verified by construction/inspection and cross-compilation only, not by running on the Tang.
- The brief's literal verification command (`OS_IMAGE=build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw` with `make -C firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke`) cannot resolve: `make -C` runs recipes in the app directory, so I reproduced the failure (`cp: cannot stat 'build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw'`), then ran the same build with the repo-absolute image path that the repo's own `tools/build-ae350-probe.sh` passes. The failure was only in the unrelated `flash.raw` copy step.
- Interpretation: the back buffer is refreshed at the moment it is presented (i.e. only when `FRAMES` advanced), not redundantly every iteration; every presented buffer always holds the current LCD.
- `T89_PAD_IDENT`/`T89_PAD_FAILS` are declared but unused (contract completeness only).
- `presented`/`FRAMES` comparisons use `!=` on wrapping counters; a 2^32 advance between polls (impossible at this rate) would be missed.

### BLOCKERS

None. (On-hardware confirmation of frames/input is out of scope and explicitly forbidden.)

VERDICT: PASS
COMMANDS:
- `make -C firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke OS_IMAGE=build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw TIEMU_ROOT=$PWD/third_party/tiemu` → exit 2, `cp: cannot stat 'build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw'` (relative OS_IMAGE cannot resolve from the `-C` directory; reported, not a code failure)
- `make -C firmware/apps/tiemu_smoke OS_IMAGE=$PWD/build/private/TI89Titanium_OS.raw TIEMU_ROOT=$PWD/third_party/tiemu` → exit 0, size output above
- `riscv-none-elf-readelf -h …/tiemu_smoke.elf`, `riscv-none-elf-nm …`, `sha256sum …`, `stat -c %s …`, `strings -a … | grep Tiny89`, `objcopy -O binary …`
- `riscv-none-elf-gcc <app flags> -Wall -Wextra -Wformat=2 -c main.c` (object written under `build/`)
- `bash tests/run_t89_pad_test.sh` → `t89_pad: 188 checks passed`
- `git status --porcelain`, `git diff --stat`, `git diff --name-only`
EVIDENCE: build exit 0 with `text 4627178 data 34584 bss 455636`; ELF 9,805,012 bytes, SHA-256 `8943f1550b6e1319ab94cb37c7f4e59762e877d33bee8fa72f1bec86e0229294`, entry `0x40000000`; all required printf strings present in the image; new code warning-free under `-Wall -Wextra -Wformat=2`; only the three permitted files modified; no deployment or board command executed; on-hardware behaviour not verified (forbidden).
